purpose: Design of target resolution, DLID embedding, and ToC build: argument rules, change-set detection, candidate finalization, completion output with a detail file, and write units.
summary: I/O and execution boundary: build never rewrites Index target documents; completion returns only counts and items to stdout
Target resolution: argument combinations, directory/pattern expansion, exclusion, path normalization, symlinks, Markdown detection
ID confirmation: documents lacking or duplicating doc_link_id are excluded from the confirmed target list and reported
DLID embedding operation: explicit invocation, duplicate original selection, section ID issuance, 60-bit Crockford Base32 IDs
Change set: new, leaving, path change, content hash change, reference change, plus section-level add/delete/move/heading/body changes
Candidate building: reuse AI-generated info, generate only when needed, validate candidates, publish ToC atomically
Completion output: finalization result, per-type counts, generated count, reference check, excluded documents, detail file path
Detail file: full change set and generated documents, one per ToC key under .temp/doc-link/index-docs/, replaced atomically
Write units: os.replace for document info and ToC, no locking, earlier document info not rolled back on failure
Completion and rerun: no notification state, failure diagnostics, re-evaluation from confirmed ToC and actual files
tasks: Implementing or modifying the index-docs build process
Implementing target specification parsing and expansion
Implementing change-set detection between ToC and actual files
Designing or testing the build completion output and detail file
Reviewing ToC candidate validation and atomic publication
Handling build failure and rerun behavior
title: DES-005 対象確定・DLID 付与・[ToC]構築設計
